title: Migrate Engine To Schema First Openapi And Graphql
summary: Engine REST OpenAPI is served from hand-written openapi/schema.json (runtime injects info.version). GraphQL uses Ariadne + graphql/schema.graphql SDL with resolvers; removed Graphene and starlette-graphene3 from engine deps. Removed generateSchemas and Pydantic JSON-schema export helpers; build.ts no longer invokes codegen; PyInstaller bundles graphql/schema.graphql and openapi/schema.json. composeonschema JSON files remain manually maintained. Domain Graphene types in compose/py are unchanged (unused by engine).
